post.text:
This is not leadership. It’s punching down on the most vulnerable people, after ripping away their support. 

If you want to solve homelessness, house people. Instead, Luxon’s pushed more people into homelessness & is now criminalising people for not having a home, and nowhere else to go.

source.agency_name: Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand
